acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a cross-module-change task at the boundary-check step, When the supervisor prepares it, Then baseSkillForStep resolves nit:boundary-check to a SKILL.md that exists on disk.

Given the boundary-check step, When the reviewer runs it, Then it emits a schema-valid step output reporting whether the change respects the module boundaries, using an existing result type rather than a new one.
Given a boundary-check that cannot be performed, When the reviewer stops, Then it emits the TASK-018 blocked contract rather than a skill-specific convention.
Given the routing conformance test, When it runs, Then the not-yet-implemented allowlist is empty.
